description:

title: MakeMyTrip acquires majority stake in Quick Ride
description:
Travel technology platform MakeMyTrip has acquired a majority stake in Bengaluru-based shared mobility startup Quick Ride, marking its entry into the ride pooling segment. The acquisition will expand MakeMyTrip’s ground transportation portfolio and strengthen its presence in daily urban commutes.

description:

The round also saw participation from existing investors Omnivore, Theia Ventures, Aureolis Ventures and Spectrum Impact, along with VC Grid and strategic angel investors.

description:
Bengaluru-based consumer AI and entertainment company EloElo Group has raised $80 million in a Series C funding round led by Hornbill Capital and NBCUniversal. The round also saw participation from MIT Investment Co. and existing investors Play Ventures, Kalaari Capital, Waterbridge Ventures, Griffin Gaming Partners and others.

title: Peppermint Robotics raises Rs 100 Cr in Pre-Series B led by pi Ventures, Crane Venture Partners
description:
Pune-based robotics startup Peppermint Robotics has raised Rs 100 crore (around $10.5 million) in a Pre-Series B funding round led by pi Ventures and Crane Venture Partners. The round also saw participation from Asiana Fund.
The investment comprises a combination of primary capital and secondary share transactions.

title: Razorpay receives SEBI approval for IPO
description:
Fintech unicorn Razorpay has received approval from the Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) for its initial public offering (IPO), according to sources familiar with the development.
The Bengaluru-based company had confidentially filed its draft red herring prospectus (DRHP) with SEBI in June 2026.
According to an Economic Times report, Razorpay is targeting to raise Rs 5,500-6,500 crore through its IPO at an expected valuation of $5 billion (Rs 49,000-50,000 crore).

title: GIVA raises over $100 Mn in funding round led by Multiples PE
description:
Multiples Alternate Asset Management, along with its co-investors, has led a $100 million-plus funding round in fine jewellery brand GIVA. The investment will help the company expand its retail network, strengthen manufacturing capabilities and scale its omnichannel presence.
The company plans to expand its retail network to over 1,000 outlets in the next three to five years, according to a press release.

description:
Wealthtech platform PowerUp Money has raised $10 million in a funding round led by Flourish Ventures, with participation from existing investors Peak XV Partners, Accel, Blume Ventures, Kae Capital, 8i Ventures and DeVC.
Back in December 2025, PowerUp Money had raised $12 million in Series A funding round led by Peak XV and others.

title: Health-tech startup Clinics On Cloud raises $12.5 Mn in Series A round
description:
Pune-based health-tech startup Clinics On Cloud has raised $12.5 million in a Series A funding round from Dubai-based investors through Model42, powered by Enlightened Minds Investments.
The fresh funds will be used to strengthen its artificial intelligence (AI)-led healthcare capabilities, expand research and development (R&D), and grow its connected microclinic network, Clinics On Cloud said in a press release.

title: Clean energy deployment platform Two Point O Capital raises $10 Mn led by Transition VC
description:
Two Point O Capital (TW.O), an AI-powered clean energy deployment platform for commercial and industrial (C&I) businesses, has raised $10 million in a funding round led by Transition Venture Capital. title: Bijnis rebrands as Zorit, raises Rs 27 Cr led by Sparrow Capital
description:

title: Jio Platforms lists at 21% premium, values company at Rs 12.5 lakh crore
description:
Reliance Industries-backed Jio Platforms made a strong stock market debut on Wednesday, with its shares listing at a premium of around 21% over the issue price of Rs 1,119.
The shares listed at Rs 1,358 on the National Stock Exchange (NSE), giving investors a gain of Rs 239 per share. At the listing price, the company commanded a market capitalisation of around Rs 12.5 lakh crore, making it India’s second-largest listed company by market value.

description:
AI inference infrastructure startup Simplismart has raised $14 million in a Series B funding round led by Dallas Venture Capital, with participation from NVIDIA, Accel, Shastra VC and Micromax.
The fresh funds will be used to strengthen its inference engine and orchestration platform, expand its cloud provider network and support its growth across North America and other global markets.

company: Practo Co Founder Shashank Nds Startup Cent
title: Practo co-founder Shashank ND’s startup Cent raises $15 Mn led by Blume, acquires Medsee
description:
Preventive healthcare startup Cent has raised $15 million in a Series A funding round co-led by Blume Ventures and South Park Commons. The company has also acquired AI radiology platform Medsee.
The round saw participation from individual investors Arun Sarin, Srinivas Narayanan, Sharath Narayana, Aprameya Radhakrishna and Krishan Sridhar, Cent founder Shashank ND said in a LinkedIn post.
